scope: frozen F160 TRAIN positive attribution; historical TEST gene effects only descriptive; no test-based gene selection
selection: top40 positive TRAIN attribution; second analysis removes RPL/RPS prefixes from both background and selected genes before ranking
universe: all 1838 genes actually covered by TRAIN prototypes; remove RPL/RPS only in nonribosomal analysis; unannotated genes retained
pathway_filter: 5<=number of pathway genes in actual background<=500
statistic: upper-tail hypergeometric overrepresentation and observed/expected overlap
matched_null: 10000 sets per analysis; without replacement within each set; joint quintiles of mean raw count/detection rate across all TRAIN B cells, plus prototype-token coverage bins1-2/3-5/6-8; selected genes remain eligible
multiplicity: BH across all tested terms in both analyses and all3 collections, separately for hypergeometric and matched p; also within-analysis q as explicitly secondary
claims: pathway association of positive model sensitivity; no pathway activation direction or biological causality; overlapping GO/Reactome entries are not independent mechanisms
